title: Scramblin’ Man
description: Whoa, Nelly! It’s a Crocco-Toon. In this adventure, Crocco the Egg must find a way to opt out of an Easter cake recipe.
altHero: egg with crocodile feet and tail running away from a bewildered chef
alt2: chef cracking an egg into the batter
alt3: Crocco the egg standing up, now Easter ecorated, in a bowl of egg dye
alt4: the chef hugging Crocco the egg with hearts surrounding them
